blockingIssues.description: src/transport/daemon.rs recreates tokio::time::sleep(poll_interval) inside select loop; sustained IPC traffic can starve daemon_tick cadence.
src/store.rs attached registry operations remain unlocked read-modify-write and use fixed temp-path writes, so concurrent writers can lose updates/race.
src/wagner.rs URL parser treats ':' in scheme URLs with ports as branch delimiters, misparsing sources like https://host:8443/repo.
src/terminal/mod.rs token replacement collides with marker-like input (e.g., 'my/task' vs 'my_s_task'), so session names are not collision-safe.
src/terminal/mod.rs strips unsupported characters instead of encoding, introducing additional collisions (e.g., 'hello@world' vs 'helloworld').

suggestedGuidanceUpdates.evidence: Multiple reviews observed code edits before test creation while handoff.skillFeedback reported followedProcedure=true (fix-detach-guard-managed-tasks, fix-repo-spec-parse-urls, fix-send-keys-delay-consistency, fix-git-and-persistence-issues, fix-tui-ux-issues, fix-daemon-ipc-latency).

suggestedGuidanceUpdates.suggestion: Add daemon-loop guidance: cadence-sensitive periodic work in tokio::select! should use persistent interval/timer state to avoid starvation under hot IPC channels.
suggestedGuidanceUpdates.evidence: Review of fix-daemon-ipc-latency found daemon_tick starvation risk from per-iteration sleep reset.

suggestedGuidanceUpdates.evidence: Review of fix-smart-approve-and-cli-flags noted public hidden status-injection helpers added to production API and no shared convention describing acceptable alternatives.
